fact: Lei n.º 03/2016 on protection of personal data was passed by the National Assembly on 15 February 2016, promulgated on 18 March 2016 and published in Diário da República n.º 39 on 10 May 2016; it enters into force 'nos termos legais', with no commencement date stated.

Lei n.º 03/2016 names the Agência Nacional de Protecção de Dados Pessoais (ANPDP) as supervisory authority and says its organic law, staff and members' statute are to be approved by a later law of the National Assembly; the document records no appointment.
ANPDP director José Costa Alegre gave a press briefing on the agency's activities and its monitoring of public and private entities' compliance with data protection law.
